41035.notes: Oregon tax-foreclosure county — Klamath acquires fee title and does NOT sell tax liens/certificates to investors. County publishes foreclosure lists (e.g. 2024 list redemption ends 09/24/2026; 2025 list redemption ends 10/07/2027 — updated 02/05/2026). Resale via Klamath County Property Sales portal (klamath.countypropertysales.com) and Sheriff property sale notices when inventory posts — public sale notice published 4 consecutive weeks in Herald and News. Tax Office 541-883-4297. Klamath Falls / basin timber and ag market — water rights, septic, and access DD essential.
